index_metadata.name: Holo UI Vault — Unified Dual-Dimension Index
index_metadata.description: Style taxonomy, functional classification with 7-dimension Feature Tokens, and harmonization rules. Component paths are in ROUTER.json; token specification in FEATURE_TOKENS.md.

rules: DO NOT read beautifului-components/index.html (32KB human visual preview, wastes tokens).
DO NOT recursively scan directories. Use ROUTER.json for component paths.
Single-task retrieval budget: maximum 1 snippet file + 1 shared CSS file.
Use ROUTER.json for fast path resolution, and FEATURE_TOKENS.md for multi-dimensional disambiguation.
Review STYLE_AND_SELECTION_GUIDE.md prior to combining different styles.

style_harmonization.principle: Beautiful UI provides interaction skeletons; Apple HIG provides visual tokens and physics. They can be seamlessly blended without conflict.
rules: When embedding Beautiful UI components into an Apple-themed project, map container radii to var(--apple-radius-lg) or var(--apple-radius-xl).
Replace dark solid surfaces with Apple Liquid Glass material: background: var(--apple-material-regular); backdrop-filter: var(--apple-blur-regular);
Ensure all clickable elements satisfy the Apple 44pt minimum touch boundary.
Adopt Apple Spring curve: transition-timing-function: var(--apple-ease-spring);
Maintain a single primary style hierarchy per viewport. Do not mix sharp brutalist elements with soft squircles.
Pair Rewamp UI tactile buttons (slide-to-confirm-button, shimmer-button) with Beautiful UI's dense data tables for high-impact action points.
Rewamp UI components use SF Pro and squircle radii, aligning natively with Apple HIG foundations.
When integrating Rewamp UI 3D AI Orbs, contain them in Apple Liquid Glass or Beautiful UI dark cards to maintain visual continuity.
Embed loading.dev micro-indicators (e.g., ld-arc, ld-linear-dots) directly inside Beautiful UI prompt bars and table cells for zero-runtime lightweight feedback without layout shift.
When embedding loading.dev indicators into Apple HIG layouts, set color: var(--apple-accent-blue) or var(--apple-text-secondary) and size to 16px-22px to match SF Pro symbol scales.
Never replace full 3D assistant fluid orbs (Rewamp UI) with micro-spinners; use micro-spinners strictly for atomic operation states.
Embed minimal theme toggles (themetoggle-components) into Beautiful UI or Apple HIG headers with zero CSS conflicts; currentColor automatically adapts to parent typography.
Pair ObsidianUI partner cards (split-showcase) with Apple HIG squircle containers and subtle spring physics for high-fidelity co-marketing showcases.
Pair Arc tactile controls (button, segmented-control, hold-to-confirm) with Beautiful UI or Apple HIG layouts for fluid spring micro-interactions.

feature_tokens_schema.cardinality: Exactly one value per dimension for every component. All 47 values are globally unique.

router_metadata.name: Holo UI Vault — Agent Router v2
context_guards: DO NOT read beautifului-components/index.html (32KB preview, wastes tokens).
DO NOT scan directories. Use paths from this file or manifests.
Budget: max 1 snippet + 1 shared CSS per task.
For ambiguous requests, filter by feature tokens in INDEX.json (spec in FEATURE_TOKENS.md).
Review STYLE_AND_SELECTION_GUIDE.md only when mixing multiple styles.

ai_native_productivity.name: AI-Native Productivity (Source: Beautiful UI)
ai_native_productivity.aesthetic: Cold neutral, dark-first, high information density, 0.5px hairlines, tabular figures, subtle shimmer transitions.
when_to_use: LLM reasoning and thinking chain display
Token streaming with source citations
Agent tool call and file modification chips
Human-in-the-loop permission and confirmation flow
Multi-modal prompt composition
Code and data revision comparison
AI SaaS, agent dashboards, terminal/CLI-inspired web apps
when_not_to_use: Generic ecommerce stores, landing pages, children apps, casual mobile games

apple_human_interface.name: Apple Human Interface (Source: Apple HIG)
apple_human_interface.aesthetic: Humanist, tactile spatial depth, continuous squircle curvature, liquid glass blur, spring physics, 44pt touch friendliness.
when_to_use: Consumer-facing applications, mobile web apps and PWAs
System settings, preference panels, grouped form lists
Contextual overlays: Action Sheets, Bottom Sheets, Alerts
Tactile card layouts with soft shadows and inner specular highlights
Interfaces prioritizing readability, visual breathing room, and accessibility
when_not_to_use: Ultra-dense financial ticker screens, raw hacker CLI terminals

kinetic_motion_tactile.name: Kinetic Motion & Tactile Physics (Source: Rewamp UI)
kinetic_motion_tactile.aesthetic: Physical spring damping, continuous fluid morphing, 3D orbital rotations, kinetic typography, Lilac & Orange accent palette.
when_to_use: High-converting landing pages, interactive product demos, and hero sections
High-friction user confirmations requiring physical slide feedback
Tactile interactive buttons with shimmer streaks, rainbow borders, or metallic chrome outlines
Theme switches with ambient sky / day-night orbs
Animated search pills that fluidly expand into omnibox inputs
Kinetic typography reveals
3D card decks and orbital carousels
3D fluid assistant orbs for AI companions
when_not_to_use: Data-dense tabular spreadsheets where motion causes distraction
Low-bandwidth environments requiring zero-JavaScript plain HTML pages

micro_motion_indicators.name: Micro-Motion Loaders & Spinners (Source: loading.dev)
micro_motion_indicators.aesthetic: Minimalist, zero-runtime, pure CSS/SVG, hairline single strokes, 3x3 pixel matrices, and 3D quantum wireframes.
when_to_use: Inline button submission indicators ('Processing', 'Saving')
Conversational typing bubbles ('Agent is typing...')
Sensor detection, radar scanning, and web crawling exploration tools
AI reasoning warmup and token streaming buffers
Card container skeletons and avatar loading bounds
Two-way data synchronization and background worker progress
when_not_to_use: Heavy interactive product landing hero demonstrations requiring fluid physics (use Rewamp UI instead)
Step-by-step collapsible thought tree inspection (use Beautiful UI thinking-state instead)

minimal_theme_toggles.name: Minimalist Theme Toggles (Source: toggles.dev)
minimal_theme_toggles.aesthetic: Pure CSS/SVG, 1em vector morphing, zero-runtime, accessible, clip-path and path transitions, reduced-motion guards.
when_to_use: Compact top navigation bar and header dark-mode switches
Minimalist toolbars and settings cards requiring 1em vector scaling
Zero-dependency vanilla HTML/CSS interfaces
Subtle animated sun-to-moon, eclipse, and toggle transitions
when_not_to_use: Large atmospheric hero switches requiring full-screen sky particles (use day-night-sky-toggle instead)
High-friction destructive action gates (use slide-to-confirm-button instead)

obsidian_tactile_showcase.name: Obsidian Tactile Showcase (Source: ObsidianUI)
obsidian_tactile_showcase.aesthetic: Apple-style spring physics, expanding rounded corners, outward shift on hover, partner split cards, and dotted divider.
when_to_use: Interactive dual partner or sponsor showcase cards
Feature comparison and landing page split presentations
Interactive Apple-style spring cards with outward translation and elevation
when_not_to_use: Multi-row data tables, dense dashboard grids, text-only blogs

arc_motion_primitives.name: Arc Motion Primitives (Source: uiarc.dev)
arc_motion_primitives.aesthetic: OKLCH color system, motion/react physics-based spring curves, useMorphWidth dynamic resize, and zero layout shift micro-interactions.
when_to_use: Tactile UI controls and micro-interactions requiring spring physics and dynamic morphing
OKLCH color spaces with native accessibility and contrast guarantees
Smooth data visualization charts with adaptive multi-series palette
Fluid segmented controls, toggles, sliders, and confirmation buttons
when_not_to_use: Heavy 3D WebGL scenes requiring Three.js (use Rewamp UI or particle orbs)
